issues.explanation: The inflected surface 頼ん is read たのん, not the dictionary-form reading たのむ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to たのん.

issues.explanation: The て-form stem 聞い is read きい, not きく.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to きい.

issues.explanation: This is the inflected auxiliary surface い, so its contextual reading is い, not いる.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to い.

issues.explanation: The passive construction uses the 未然形 笑わ, read わらわ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to わらわ.

issues.explanation: In this context 会 refers to the literary/arts association or club, not simply a meeting.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a meaning such as “association” or “club.”

issues.explanation: In 東風が帰ると, が marks 東風 as the subject; it does not mean “when.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use “subject marker”; assign the temporal meaning to the following と.

issues.explanation: 捺印 means affixing a seal or a seal impression, not generally “sealing.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use “affixing a seal” or “seal impression.”

issues.explanation: The inflected surface 食べ is read たべ, not the dictionary-form reading たべる.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to たべ.

issues.explanation: The negative form uses the 未然形 気づか, read きづか.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to きづか.

issues.explanation: The surface なかっ is read なかっ; なかった is the combined form with the following た.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to なかっ.

issues.explanation: The て-form stem 届い is read とどい, not とどく.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to とどい.

issues.explanation: Attributive な is the attributive form of the auxiliary だ, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Change type to auxiliary.

issues.explanation: In 真面目な文体で, で is the case particle meaning “in/by,” not an inflection of だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Use lemma で and meaning “in/by (a style).”

issues.explanation: The continuative surface 嘆き is read なげき, not なげく.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to なげき.

issues.explanation: The surface でき is read でき, not the dictionary-form reading できる.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to でき.

issues.explanation: Here しよう is the volitional form of the main verb する in 御馳走しよう, not an auxiliary.
issues.suggested_fix: Change type to word while retaining lemma する and kana しよう.

issues.explanation: The continuative surface 冗談めかし is read じょうだんめかし, not じょうだんめかす.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to じょうだんめかし.

issues.explanation: The て-form stem 書い is read かい, not かく.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to かい.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the progressive/state construction 〜ている with past tense, meaning “had been listening.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning 聞いていた for progressive/state 〜ている＋past.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the passive construction 笑われる, meaning “be laughed at.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a passive overlay spanning 笑われ.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for と言う used as a hearsay/reporting expression, “it is said that.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning という.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the temporal conditional pattern V-ると, “when/upon hearing.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning 聞くと.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the temporal conditional pattern V-ると, “when/upon returning.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning 帰ると.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the past negative construction 〜なかった, “did not notice.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning 気づかなかった.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for the negative conditional pattern 〜なければ, “if unable/not able to prepare.”
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning できなければ.

issues.explanation: The annotation lacks an overlay for 〜てある, the resultative construction indicating that something has been written and remains so.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a grammar overlay spanning 書いてある.
